stories.sz: 密歇根州首位当选的穆斯林参议员阿卜杜勒·埃尔-赛义德讨论了他的历史性胜利、与特朗普在以色列军事援助问题上达成的不寻常一致以及依然存在的政治分歧。

stories.t: Nadal set to join Real Madrid board of directors
stories.s: Tennis great Rafael Nadal is set to join the board of Spanish football giants Real Madrid.
stories.tz: 纳达尔将加入皇家马德里董事会
stories.sz: 网坛巨星拉斐尔·纳达尔即将加入西班牙足球豪门皇家马德里的董事会。

stories.t: Sharp objects found in Halloween sweets in three European nations
stories.s: Dozens of cases are reported in Austria, Germany and Hungary, including a nine-year-old girl hurting her tongue while eating chocolate containing a pin.
stories.tz: 欧洲三国万圣节糖果中发现尖锐异物
stories.sz: 奥地利、德国和匈牙利报告了数十起类似案件，其中包括一名9岁女孩在吃含有大头针的巧克力时舌头受伤。

stories.t: The world is reacting to the Democrats' sweeping midterm elections victory
stories.s: From Kyiv to Moscow, and Tehran to Tel Aviv, all eyes were on the Democrats' big win as foreign powers weigh how a flipped Congress will affect international relations.
stories.tz: 世界各方对民主党在中期选举中大胜作出反应
stories.sz: 从基辅到莫斯科，从德黑兰到特拉维夫，随着外国势力权衡国会更迭将如何影响国际关系，所有目光都聚焦于民主党的重大胜利。

stories.t: Israel’s election commission rejects Netanyahu claims of voting fraud

stories.tz: 以色列选举委员会拒绝内塔尼亚胡关于选举舞弊的指控
stories.sz: 在此之前，总检察长阻止了辛贝特（以色列国家安全总局）审问巴勒斯坦族政党政客的要求。以色列选举委员会周三确认了上周选举的最终结果，该结果剥夺了本雅明·内塔尼亚胡的……

stories.t: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline
stories.s: As South Africans vote in local elections, residents tell the BBC they are tired of the poor quality of services they get.
stories.tz: 非国大面临扭转南非衰落的压力
stories.sz: 随着南非人参加地方选举，当地居民向BBC表示，他们已经对糟糕的服务质量感到厌倦。

stories.t: Rwanda's army team removed from Africa league after US sanctions, NBA says
stories.s: The US imposed sanctions on Rwanda's army over its role in the conflict in DR Congo.
stories.tz: NBA称卢旺达军队球队因美国制裁被逐出非洲联赛
stories.sz: 美国因卢旺达军队在刚果（金）冲突中所扮演的角色对其实施了制裁。

stories.t: Delhi air quality worsens ahead of Diwali as firework restrictions enter force
stories.s: On Wednesday morning, Delhi's air quality index reading stood at 377, in the "very poor" category.
